Hero_Desc_Haley:
A retired Elven Army officer who believes she is still on active duty.
Due to the PTSD she received from the invasion of Earth, she has become delusional, thinking she now lives in "Elias," an allied state.
Even now, she continues to work hard to bring peace to her imaginary world.
Album_Hobby_Haley: Interacting with the denizens of Elias.
Album_Wish_Haley: Being remembered as a good friend.
Album_Haley1: My first encounter with Haley was unique. From a distance, she yelled out excitedly. I assumed it was another elf with PTSD and quietly tried to walk past her. But before I knew it, she sprinted towards me at full speed, shaking my hand repeatedly, overjoyed to meet an ally from her federation in a place like this.
Album_Haley2: Judging from her personality alone, Haley is actually a decent elf. Unlike other elves, she isn't arrogant, and her advice is surprisingly reasonable. Among all elves, Haley might be the only one I genuinely respect.
Album_Haley3: Haley's daily routine involves what she calls "field exchange," which is basically just walking around Elias looking for denizens in need. Most of the time, the results aren't as impressive as she makes them sound, but... at least she tries.
Album_Haley4: Many elves seem to look up to Haley as a role model. In particular, Canna and the Suppression Unit, who were former soldiers, treat Haley with great respect.
Album_Haley5: Unlike other elves, Haley isn't afraid of humans. When I asked why, she explained that she used to be scared but overcame it through understanding and experience. Now, she believes that the justice she learned from humans should be spread among the elves.
Album_Haley6: Haley is the only elf who genuinely takes her role in the Order seriously. Unlike sprites like Ner, who have deep faith, Haley simply finds Yggdrasil fascinating. When I asked why an elf would be so friendly toward the Yggdrasil Order, she gave me a puzzled look and said, "I've even been granted an extension on my life. Isn't it weirder not to be happy about that?" Now that I think about it... she has a point.
Album_Haley7: Elena seems to consider Haley a huge headache. She mentioned that she has no real way to keep Haley in check. It seems like retired soldiers hold a special status in elven society.

LoveLetter_Haley: Dear Master, how are you doing? Thanks to you, Elias is peaceful today as well. It may sound obvious, but you're quite a capable human. Back when I was on Earth, if there had been humans like you, I could have carried out my missions much more smoothly. To be frank, I wasn't too fond of my Earth friends. Even when I protested our treatment, they didn't take it seriously. That's why I can't help but hold you in high regard. I pay my respects to your hard work. Come visit Monatium sometime and I'll treat you well.
LoveCall_Haley:
This is Halo. Guardian, do you read me?
Hmm? Have you forgotten our code phrase? Dear, dear. Security during communications is important.
Even now, alien galactic forces may be attempting to jam or intercept our transmission!

Hmm? Why did I radio you?
W-Well. I called you because... a mission! There is a mission.
A top-secret mission that only the two of us can carry out!
We must sweep through downtown Monatium together and uncover the evil forces hiding within the city!
Blending in among the citizens, we will investigate restaurants, theaters, parks, and many other locations!
Hmm? A d-date?! I understand you are excited about a mission after so long, but do not misunderstand!
Th-This is strictly... an important mission for the sake of peace.
Ahem! In any case, meet me in front of Monatium City Hall.
I will be waiting! Over and out!
